story: Discover the stunning Black Backed Dwarf Kingfisher (*Ceyx erithaca*), a member of the diverse Alcedinidae family. Native to Lowland forests near streams/ponds; gardens; parks; wooded areas; and mangroves, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Near Threatened (NT) on the IUCN Red List, the Black Backed Dwarf Kingfisher represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
